findings.title: Hidden index flags allow destructive worktree misclassification
findings.before: A tracked file modified behind assume-unchanged or skip-worktree can yield an empty status. Non-force Git worktree removal still deletes it; preserving HEAD does not preserve that uncommitted content.
findings.source_fix: Capture the -v NUL index stream before/after observation, protect both flags, include flags in the metadata digest, and block sparse-checkout or unreadable operation markers.
findings.verification_scope: Actual Git reproduction and independent guarded-recipe check; Rust capture/removal wrapper unrun. Same-user concurrent writes still require coordination.

findings.title: ACP path guard rejects normal Windows roots but under-validates nonexistent file names
findings.before: Canonicalizing a Windows root creates a verbatim path that the local path validator rejects. A nonexistent target was checked through its parent without first validating the complete target spelling (including ADS/ambiguous names).
findings.source_fix: Keep a validated normal root spelling, lexically validate the whole requested path, distinguish true NotFound from other errors, reject dangling links and protected configuration directories.
findings.verification_scope: Source trace plus Rust canonicalize documentation. Native Windows path, ADS and provider callback tests are authored, not run. This is policy, not filesystem isolation.

findings.title: Codex completion notification can be lost before the turn/start reply
findings.before: The RPC request loop discarded a terminal turn notification arriving before the request response. The subsequent waiter could wait until timeout for an event already received.
findings.source_fix: Retain only bounded terminal thread/turn/status metadata, consume it in the turn waiter, and cap the pending terminal queue at 32.
findings.verification_scope: Control-flow review and independent event-order reference; real Codex/Rust transport unrun.

findings.title: Known unsupported Gemini read-only continuation fails after starting a session
findings.before: The pre-existing unsupported read-only guard occurred only after connecting, authenticating and creating/loading a vendor session.
findings.source_fix: Reject this known unsupported combination before connect or session creation.
findings.verification_scope: Static call-order verification. Does not certify another provider mode as a sandbox.

findings.title: Quarantine undo and absence checks could conflate lookup failures with absence
findings.before: Path.exists/is_ok patterns hide errors or dangling entries; restore also lacked full post-rename verification.
findings.source_fix: Introduce strict entry_exists/require_absent, validate the original path, and recheck restored identity/content plus source disappearance. Preserve uncertainty after partial effects.
findings.verification_scope: Source checks and Linux filesystem semantics; no real quarantine/Windows socket action executed. Rename races are not claimed eliminated.

findings.title: Archive approval did not bind exact selected records
findings.before: The approved archive operation contained only cutoff and count. New qualifying records or payload changes could change what execution archived after approval.
findings.source_fix: Add an exact bounded selection digest to the operation, deterministic tie-breaking and execution-time re-selection before any archive write. Change the effects policy ID to require replanning.
findings.verification_scope: Exact shipped SQL selection executed with Python SQLite; Rust plan digest/executor unrun.

findings.title: Archive builds oversized payload collections before enforcing its byte budget
findings.before: Record count was checked too late (including an off-by-one), and the aggregate byte ceiling was enforced only after retaining/serializing the full pack.
findings.source_fix: Enforce aggregate encoded-entry and record limits before retaining each entry, reserve header space, use checked arithmetic, and verify hydrated pack size/project binding.
findings.verification_scope: Independent bounded reference plus static wiring; no native memory benchmark or archive executor run.

findings.title: Failed restore can leave an apparently usable partial home
findings.before: After copying the database, a failure restoring required archive dependencies left a normal-looking initialized home; future opens did not know restore was unfinished.
findings.source_fix: Create and sync restore.pending before data copy, reject normal and read-only opens while present, and remove it only after dependencies and integrity checks succeed.
findings.verification_scope: Marker/error-path source audit and reference fixture; crash-injection against the Rust restore is still required.

findings.title: Backup/restore structural checks omit foreign-key integrity
findings.before: SQLite integrity_check/quick_check can return ok for broken foreign keys. The prior backup/restore health checks could accept internally inconsistent project/resource relationships.
findings.source_fix: Run PRAGMA foreign_key_check during owned DB health, backup validation and before restoring a source.
findings.verification_scope: Actual SQLite reproduction with shipped schemas; Rust wrapper and Windows backup unrun.

findings.title: Vault can write an accepted secret that its reader rejects
findings.before: A 16 KiB byte value serialized as decimal JSON can exceed 64 KiB before DPAPI overhead, but the ciphertext reader was capped at 64 KiB.
findings.source_fix: Share a 16 KiB plaintext and 128 KiB ciphertext limit across legacy/versioned paths; reject oversized ciphertext before writing and invalid plaintext after unprotect.
findings.verification_scope: Actual serialization-size reference using a valid UTF-8 secret. No DPAPI operation executed; native maximum-size roundtrip tests authored.

findings.title: Windows secret-lifecycle branch references Path without importing it
findings.before: The Windows-only implementation names Path::new without std::path::Path in scope, a direct source-level name-resolution defect.
findings.source_fix: Add the cfg(windows) Path import alongside Read/Write.
findings.verification_scope: Static import/name audit, not an executed compiler diagnostic. The full tree may still contain other compilation defects.

findings.title: Plan-fit utilization can combine different accounts
findings.before: Completed cycles had provider and bucket but no explicit account identity, so apparently comparable cycles from different subscriptions could be aggregated.
findings.source_fix: Add optional account_alias to the wire shape; missing identity produces unknown, mixed accounts reject, and complete-cycle keys include account.
findings.verification_scope: Independent identity references and source assertions. Old imports are still parseable, but now need explicit account identity for a plan-fit verdict.

findings.title: Finite economic inputs can produce nonfinite derived results
findings.before: Tiny positive denominators and large even-median sums can create infinity; some derived outputs could then be serialized as null or reported without an explicit numeric boundary.
findings.source_fix: Use finite-ratio guards, overflow-safe median arithmetic, reject impossible scenario rates and withhold unsupported ratios.
findings.verification_scope: Independent IEEE-754 reference checks; no claim of executed Rust math or calibrated forecast confidence.

findings.title: Optional context sections can prevent all project context
findings.before: A failing discovery/economics/cache/timeline helper propagated its error, hiding essential decisions/resources/Work Items too.
findings.source_fix: Collect optional sections as bounded success or typed failure metadata; preserve essential authoritative lookups as fail-closed.
findings.verification_scope: Static flow review; authored Rust optional-section tests remain unrun.

findings.title: Reviewed candidate count can exceed the discovery matcher budget
findings.before: The query allowed 77 imported entries on top of 27 builtins (104) while the matcher rejects more than 100, potentially disabling discovery for a growing catalog.
findings.source_fix: Enforce builtin-aware capacity during review and query, retain excess existing records rather than deleting them, and report omitted capacity.
findings.verification_scope: Packaged catalog counted plus source capacity review; actual Rust review/import transaction unrun.

findings.title: Empty strings can masquerade as trial evidence or reviewed resource metadata
findings.before: Option presence was accepted even for blank evidence/revision strings, allowing a claimed usefulness outcome without a meaningful reference.
findings.source_fix: Reject blank or oversized evidence/revision and empty reviewed resource fields; validate equivalence and feedback times.
findings.verification_scope: Input validation source fix; references still need genuine operator evaluation, not automated truth inference.

findings.title: Collision detection performs repeated all-pairs path normalization
findings.before: Large accepted actor/path inputs caused an actors-squared times paths-squared loop with repeated allocation.
findings.source_fix: Normalize once into bounded sets; use exact, ancestor and indexed-descendant checks; limit aggregate path bytes and validate actor roles/times.
findings.verification_scope: Independent reference equivalence over 2,048 path/set comparisons; not a Rust/Windows performance benchmark.

findings.title: Ownership correlation repeatedly scans bindings and accepts ambiguous prior identities
findings.before: Each ancestry step re-scanned the binding list; duplicate prior process keys and ill-ordered evidence times were insufficiently rejected.
findings.source_fix: Pre-index fresh bindings, cap ended-session evidence, validate binding time ordering, and reject duplicate previous process identities.
findings.verification_scope: Source/dataflow inspection and authored Rust regression; runtime matching untested. All processes remain protected.

findings.title: Process graph can claim complete coverage with unreadable fields
findings.before: Unreadable executable or resource fields did not always reduce coverage; resource observations used a second handle without an explicit birth consistency check.
findings.source_fix: Track field readability, reduce per-process and graph coverage, and compare handle creation time before merging resource observations.
findings.verification_scope: Native source review only. A PID-reuse exploit is not claimed reproduced; Windows collection must still be exercised.

findings.title: Malformed or future timestamps can overflow arithmetic or appear fresh
findings.before: Signal time subtraction accepted negative extreme values, and a future last-observed timestamp could produce recently-reported ownership.
findings.source_fix: Validate signal, checkpoint and lease timestamps before subtraction; exact expiry/future observations remain uncertain.
findings.verification_scope: Source reasoning/reference boundary checks; native execution and clock-jump integration deferred.

findings.title: Pinned time dependency is in a published affected version range
findings.before: time=0.3.44 falls in RUSTSEC-2026-0009 affected versions; the advisory concerns RFC2822 recursion/stack exhaustion.
findings.source_fix: Move the exact direct pin to 0.3.47, the advisory patch floor; preserve features and record the unresolved transitive audit.
findings.verification_scope: Primary advisory checked. Current code uses RFC3339; exploit reachability is NOT established. No Cargo resolution or advisory scan of a real lockfile ran.

findings.title: Some supposedly bounded config reads can block on special files or allocate without limit
findings.before: Worktrunk empty-config verification used an unbounded fs::read; config/database opens did not consistently reject non-regular files before open.
findings.source_fix: Add regular-file prechecks, exact-size bounded Worktrunk config reading and strict project-config presence checks.
findings.verification_scope: Linux special-file semantics and source checks. Path replacement races against malicious same-user writers remain outside this guard.

findings.title: Read-only report says no repairs are implemented anywhere
findings.before: The inherited report wording described the entire product as lacking cleanup/repair despite added explicit operation paths.
findings.source_fix: Clarify that this particular read-only assessment performed no cleanup or repairs.
findings.verification_scope: Documentation/output consistency correction only; not a change in authority or capability.
